depiction.primary_object: four-branched snowflake with V-shaped chevrons on each arm
modifiers: diagonal slash from top-left to bottom-right
depiction.composition: single object split by a diagonal strike-through line

readings.meaning: cooling or air conditioning turned off

ambiguity: At very small sizes, the thick diagonal slash blends with the snowflake branches, making it look like a plain snowflake or a spiky asterisk.

modifier_semantics.meaning: negation, removal, or turning off (no ice / defrost / cooling off)

task_intents: unfreeze credit report or bank card
turn off cooling for the season

example_tasks.task: Take the lasagna out of the freezer to thaw before 9am
Shut off and cover the window air conditioner for the winter
Temporarily lift the credit freeze on TransUnion and Experian
Scrape and de-ice the car windshield before the morning school run
Unplug the garage fridge and let the ice buildup melt completely
Move two packs of chicken thighs to the bottom shelf
Flip the breaker off and put the canvas cover on
Do the PIN verification online before applying for the auto loan
Empty the upright freezer into coolers and melt the thick ice off the coils
Put the frozen beef stock and mirepoix in the fridge overnight so they thaw evenly
Lift the hiring freeze on the backend engineering team once Q3 budget is signed

example_tasks_es: Descongelar el congelador del garaje antes de hacer la compra del mes
Sacar las pechugas de pollo del freezer para que se descongelen
Apagar y tapar el aire acondicionado hasta el próximo verano
example_tasks_ru: Разморозить морозилку и вымыть все ящики
Достать фарш из морозилки на ужин
Купить размораживатель замков и антилед для лобового стекла

context_tasks.task: Buy a 20lb bag of pet-safe rock salt for the driveway
Put styrofoam covers on the outside garden faucets
Replace the broken brass blade on the windshield ice scraper
Check the antifreeze coolant level in the Subaru before the mountain trip

near_misses.task: Buy frost-free outdoor sillcock valves for the hose bibs
Check if the freezer door seal is leaking cold air
Freeze leftover bone broth in silicone cubes
Book ski lessons at Whistler for the February trip
Prepare a quick icebreaker activity for Monday's team onboarding
Wipe down the sticky shelves with warm baking soda water

reasoning: A snowflake with a diagonal slash universally signifies defrosting, thawing, de-icing, or turning off cooling/AC. It maps cleanly to common household chores (defrosting a freezer, thawing meat, shutting down AC for winter, de-icing a car) and metaphorical unfreezing (lifting a credit freeze), though at tiny sizes the slash can merge with the snowflake's arms.
